description.value: Farm to Table is a full-service grocery store in downtown Vancouver's Richards Street corridor, offering an extensive range of conventional and plant-based groceries, fresh produce, dairy, meat, deli, and bakery products. It operates as both a physical retail store and an online store (currently directing online orders through third-party delivery apps). Its broad product range — including organic produce, specialty items, and ready-to-eat meals — makes it a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 29m. Total: 4 spaces.
